name: Other armed conflicts
value: Ethiopia–Eritrea forces face off at Badme
summary: Ethiopian forces reportedly retake areas near Badme on 23 Nov as Ethiopia and Eritrea keep forces massed at the border
state: ACLED reported that Ethiopian forces retook Biyara and Adi Asmerom near Badme on 23 Nov from Tigrayan and Eritrean forces, after Eritrean forces reportedly moved about 20 km into Tigray around 15 Nov and an Ethiopian drone struck Badme on 19 Nov. Reuters reported on 18 Nov that both countries have massed forces along the border (TimesLIVE). Neither government has confirmed interstate fighting and most reports are unverified, so the Alert is unconfirmed and Watch holds.
for_you: Residents of Tigray and the Ethiopia–Eritrea border areas face curfews, drone strikes and displacement. The FCDO advises against travel to parts of Ethiopia, including Tigray. A wider war would affect Red Sea security and aid routes in the Horn of Africa.
rubric_hit: Watch: significant deterioration on the Ethiopia–Eritrea border; interstate war not confirmed by either government
